extraction.Name: Robert S. Clifford
extraction.Refused/Protested: at the time he got his patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment, he did not want it, but the Indian Agency sent word down to him to send up stamps for registering his letter, containing his patent in fee, and he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: he never mortgaged his allotment, and has kept up his taxes to the year 1926, but has paid these taxes under protest, since 1922
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: has kept up his taxes to the year 1926, but has paid these taxes under protest, since 1922
extraction.Occupation/Income: Disciplinarian at the Holy Rosary Mission, at Pine Ridge, South Dakota, which is the source of his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; has no one to support but himself; has good health; has never received any aid from the County or United States Government; allotment is 160 acres
